title: User asked Grok Build to diagnose why his computer overheats
dependency_review: Inspected the imports and runtime reads of all three pcoverheat generators. gen/pcoverheat_gen.py (YouTube split), gen/pcoverheat_cutout_gen.py (TikTok cutout) and gen/pcoverheat_whiteboard.py (Instagram whiteboard) share gen/pcoverheat_scene.py and import pipeline/captions.py, pipeline/pointing_cues.py, formats/cutout/lib/{cutout_core,cutout_depthfield} and formats/whiteboard/lib/{whiteboard_build,whiteboard_fix6_core}; both lib directories ship whole because they carry their own envelope, pill-width and cap-width JSON. The cutout generator also puts F/format_lab/_shared on sys.path but imports nothing from it, so that scratch directory is deliberately not shipped. Two helper programs that produced shipped artwork are included: gen/_pcoverheat_wb_card.py, which renders gen/_wb_assets/card_pcoverheat_wb.png (read at build time by the whiteboard lane through card_pcoverheat_wb.json), and gen/_pcoverheat_proof.py, the still-proof harness for the shared scene. gen/pcoverheat_cutout_envelope.py is the alpha sweep that writes gen/_envelope_pcoverheat.json, which the cutout generator refuses to build without. Resolved runtime file reads, all included: plans/pcoverheat_plan.json (the one geometry contract for the three lanes) with its md, context, scene handoff, the cutout addendum and the three lane notes; cuts/pcoverheat (master.mp4, audio.m4a, face_full_hd.mp4, face_bottom_hd.mp4, edl.json and transcript_tight.json, which carries the take text and every word start the scene times against); prep/pcoverheat.json and the prep/stages/pcoverheat.* records (cues, cut, plate, prompt0, selection, ship, track); gen/_envelope_pcoverheat.json, _cues_pcoverheat.json, _wb_pcoverheat.json, _pillwidths.json, _df/bandframes_pcoverheat.json, _build_pcoverheat{,_cutout}.json, _birefnet_master_pcoverheat.json, the _geom and _geomstrict paperwork and the gate1, prerender, qcpass, rc, rcspec and phonepage records; and the matting session the cutout lane reads (plate.json for the over-wide plate box and origin, selection.json, matting.json for the headroom guard, ship_v5.json) with measure.json, edits.json, chair_prompt.json, _cadence_diffs.json, selection.mask.png and selection.frame.png for context. Source artwork: assets/source_pcoverheat_2084122084297359607.json plus the assets/source_pcoverheat directory it points at (the post screenshot 2084122084297359607_0.jpg, avatar_XFreeze.jpg, post_shot_pcoverheat.png and .json, shot_pcoverheat_crop.png and crop_pcoverheat.json, the crop contract both DOM lanes seat from). Raw media: the untouched Filmed recording /Users/migle/Movies/2026-09-04 13-49-31.mp4 (973 MB, the recording prep/pcoverheat.json names) and its full ASR transcript intake/transcripts/2026-09-04 13-49-31.json; the tight transcript ships inside Cut. Project assets: pcoverheat_split/assets and pcoverheat_cutout/assets are real directories containing no symlinks, and pcoverheat_whiteboard/assets is a symlink to shorts_run17/stage/pcoverheat_whiteboard that the packager must materialize. Every local src and href in the three index.html files resolves inside its own asset tree: logos codex-color, codex, x-logo.svg, grok, claude-cowork, cursor, opencode-color, copilot-color, antigravity-color, openclaw-color, github-mark and postcard.png; music bed.mp3 and bed_split.mp3; sfx click, pop, whoosh, tick, low_thump, page_turn, pen_soft3, reverse_air and soft_whoosh; v/voice.m4a, v/audio.m4a, v/face_bottom_hd.mp4, v/face_band.mp4, v/post_shot.png, source/shot_pcoverheat_crop.png, and the cutout matte.webm and matte_rim.webm, which are real copies of the v5 mattes rather than links, with their .src pointer files and _matte_source.txt alongside. External runtime dependencies, not vendorable: GSAP 3.14.2 from cdn.jsdelivr.net and Google Fonts Poppins, Nunito and JetBrains Mono, loaded by all three compositions; rendering needs the HyperFrames CLI pinned at 0.7.107 plus ffmpeg and ffprobe, and the generators run on the Workspace venv Python with numpy and Pillow (the card and proof helpers additionally need Playwright and cairosvg). Excluded on purpose: matting plate videos, the v5 webm masters already copied into the cutout project, matting-cache and prompts, review probe sheets and proof directories, and every unrelated recording. No secrets. Hashes verify the copies only; no end-to-end rebuild was run.
